sentiment.summary: AI mega-rally continues: Cisco surged 17% on earnings, S&P 500 hit new record highs, and $670B in hyperscaler capex plus 27% S&P Q1 earnings growth are driving broad tech optimism.

insights.text: AI boom lifts all boats to new records. S&P 500 hit new ATH May 14 as Cisco surged 17% on AI earnings beat. Hyperscalers plan $670B capex in 2026. S&P Q1 profits +27% YoY. Trump-Xi summit easing trade fears. Broad risk-on environment — your portfolio is aligned.

NVTS at $21.15 — more than 2x your $10 cost basis. Completed $122M ATM offering, strengthening the balance sheet. India GaN partnership with Cyient expanding TAM. Rallied 24.5% on May 11. Power semiconductors for AI data centers remain a structural growth story.

Rocket Lab at $128 — 2x your $62.19 cost basis. Q1 revenue $200.3M (+63.5% YoY) crushed estimates, backlog doubled to $2.2B. Deutsche Bank raised PT to $120, New Street initiated Buy. Market cap now $71.85B. Massive winner — trail your stop and let it run.

T1 Energy at $5.63 — still below your $6.73 cost basis (-16%). Q1 earnings beat expectations (+60% revenue), new $160M convertible notes fund Phase 1 solar fab in Austin. High beta speculative. Execution risk real but thesis intact — position is sized appropriately.

Seagate at $807 — up 80% from your $449 cost basis. Q3 EPS beat by 18%, revenue +44% YoY, FCF at decade-high $953M. Evercore raised PT to $1,000. AI data center storage demand is structural. Core winner — hold and let Evercore's $1K target play out.

Alphabet near 52-week high at $400, just above your $390.64 avg. Q1 EPS $5.11 crushed $2.62 estimates. Google Cloud +63%, Search +19%. $180B+ AI capex planned. Googlebook AI laptop launching this fall. Solid core compounder — no reason to trim.

Micron at $786 — just below your $790.62 cost, PT raised to $950. HBM and DRAM fully allocated through 2026, market's most heavily traded stock. BofA raised PT to $950. AI memory demand is a freight train — tiny unrealized loss is noise vs the long-term setup.

Microsoft at $404 — just below your $409.86 cost basis. Azure AI growth strong but massive capex pressuring free cash flow. LinkedIn cutting 5% of staff. P/E 24x reasonable. Collect the $0.91 quarterly dividend (ex-date May 21) and hold through the AI cycle.

SanDisk opened down 5.66% at $1,413 — below your $1,550.95 cost. Q3 EPS beat 59% vs estimates, data center +233%. Stock up 558% YTD — today's selloff is profit-taking after a parabolic run. Underlying fundamentals strong but volatility is extreme at these levels.

Nebius exploding — up 7.7% today to $222, +70% above your $131 cost. Q1 revenue $399M — 684% YoY growth. $27B Meta contract + U.S. gigawatt-scale AI factory. NVIDIA-funded pivot paying off massively. Fastest-growing AI infra play in your entire portfolio.

EchoStar surging 7%+ on FCC-approved $40B spectrum sale to SpaceX/AT&T. Now trading ~$135-145, well above your $114.33 cost. Up 564% over the past year. This spectrum monetization was the thesis catalyst — this is the payoff. Trail your stop up.

BigBear.ai at $4.23 — down 53% from your $9.02 cost basis. Recent 24.7% monthly bounce driven by Q1 beats and Ask Sage deal. Down 26% YTD. Avg analyst PT $5.50. Ongoing losses and dilution risk remain. Defense AI thesis intact but patience is running thin here.

Oklo sinking post-earnings — trading ~$69, still 45% below your $125 cost. Q1 net loss $33.1M on zero revenue. July 4 reactor criticality deadline is a binary catalyst — pass it and sentiment shifts; miss it and it bleeds further. New $1B ATM adds dilution risk.

BTC at $79,549 — up 8.8% from your $73,135 cost basis. Prices slipping slightly this week but institutional ETF inflows and shrinking exchange reserves remain bullish. $80K is key resistance — a clean break above targets $85K+. Small position, let it ride.
